Minors: NC 16-17 11 p.m.-5 a.m. restriction applies only before a school day and can be lifted with written parent + principal approval; enforced every night of a school week (stricter). No NC hour limits for 16-17 outside the school term.
Minors: under-16 may not work more than 5 consecutive hours without a 30-minute rest interval (G.S. 95-25.5(e)); not encoded (no minor-break rule type).

Tipped minimum wage: G.S. 95-25.3(f) caps the tip credit at the FLSA 3(m) amount ($2.13 cash wage, federal.json citation); tips must be certified and the employee may keep all tips (pools capped at 15%).

rules.summary: When school is in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on a non-school day and 18 a week, between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m., outside school hours.

citation.title: N.C. Gen. Stat. § 95-25.5 — Youth employment
citation.excerpt: No more than three hours on a day when school is in session ... (2) No more than eight hours on a day when school is not in session ... (5) No more than 18 hours in any one week

rules.summary: When school is not in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. in summer).

citation.title: N.C. Gen. Stat. § 95-25.5 — Youth employment
citation.excerpt: Only between 7 A.M. and 7 P.M., except to 9 P.M. during the summer (when school is not in session); (4) No more than 40 hours in any one week when school is not in session

rules.summary: During the school term, 16- and 17-year-olds enrolled in school may not work between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. when there is school the next day, unless the employer has written approval from a parent and the principal.

citation.title: N.C. Gen. Stat. § 95-25.5 — Youth employment
citation.excerpt: no youth under 18 years of age who is enrolled in school in grade 12 or lower may be employed between 11 P.M. and 5 A.M. when there is school for the youth the next day

rules.summary: North Carolina allows the FLSA tip credit: $2.13 cash wage, up to $5.12 of tips toward $7.25.

citation.title: N.C. Gen. Stat. § 95-25.3(f) — Minimum wage, tips
citation.excerpt: Tips earned by a tipped employee may be counted as wages only up to the amount permitted in section 3(m) of the Fair Labor Standards Act, 29 U.S.C. 203(m), if the tipped employee is notified in advance
